newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures end mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures end mostly lower.

text.p: Continued light rolling of long May contracts in July and thin pressure from a slower cash trade resulted in most months of CME lumber futures ending lower, traders said.

Funds have been rolling long May positions into July and this, coupled with the recent slowdown in cash trade, has caused May to slip under $400 per tbf. Losses were limited by continued expectations of strong cash markets into the spring, especially with mill order files already reaching out into May, they said.

Random Lengths quoted cash spruce at $410 per tbf, off $1 from midweek but still $3 over last Friday. They said that shipment dates reaching into May and double-digit price gains cooled some buyers' enthusiasm late in the week.
